name: Save matplotlib figures to run artifacts
when_to_use: Use when CodeSpatialAgent computes spatial, statistical, or tabular results that are easier to inspect as a chart or map.
verified_snippet:
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
# plot GeoDataFrame or Series here
plt.savefig(f'{OUTPUT_DIR}/spatial_result.png', dpi=120, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close(fig)
io_contract: INPUT: computed GeoDataFrame/DataFrame/Series. OUTPUT: PNG/SVG/JPG file saved under OUTPUT_DIR, which is injected by run_validated_python.
pitfalls: Always use matplotlib.use('Agg') before pyplot in headless runs
Save to OUTPUT_DIR, not an arbitrary path
